Surveyed 3 page-viewport pairs, 1305 rendered elements, measured 2026-10-10.

  system size      28 values describe the site
  colour coverage  97.6% of the colour on the page
  spacing step     4px, explaining 53.9%

· 45 distinct colours render across the pages surveyed. 12 of them account for 97.6% of the colour on the page.
· 6 colours sit within a just-noticeable difference of a colour already in use and cannot be told apart by eye — together 2.7% of the colour on the page. The heaviest is #FAFAFA, which is 1.73 from #FFFFFF.
· Spacing follows no consistent step. The closest candidate is 4px and it explains only 53.9%. A 2px step would explain 87.4%, which is not a spacing system.
· 23 spacing values sit off that step, the most frequent being 6px, which is 2px from the nearest multiple.
· 12 distinct font sizes are in use across 12 steps. The sizes sit on roughly a 1.2 ratio.
· 6 of those sizes carry under 1% of the text each, which is the signature of a one-off rather than a step.
· 11 corner radii are in use, clustering into 11 steps.
· 6 distinct shadows are in use. An elevation scale usually has two or three.
